title: Test harness: Vitest for Workers and Playwright for E2E
description: Establish unit/integration testing against the Workers runtime and end-to-end testing against a running dev server, with reusable fixtures for users and vault data. Requirement ID: TASK-6.
acceptanceCriteria: `pnpm test` runs Vitest with the Workers pool and exits non-zero on failure
`pnpm test:e2e` runs Playwright against `pnpm dev` and exits non-zero on failure
Playwright captures a screenshot and trace on failure
Fixtures create a user and vault rows without duplicating production logic
A deliberately failing assertion makes each command exit non-zero
Total E2E runtime for the placeholder suite is under 60 seconds

steps.details: Add `vitest.config.ts` using `@cloudflare/vitest-pool-workers`. Provide a test-only D1 binding pointing at a local test database and a KV namespace. Add `tsconfig` types for `cloudflare:test`.
Create `app/__test__/setup.ts` that applies migrations to the test D1 instance and truncates tables between test files. Ensure tests never touch the development database.
Add `playwright.config.ts` with `webServer` running `pnpm dev --port 8787`, baseURL, one chromium project, trace `on-first-retry`, screenshot `only-on-failure`. Add `e2e/` directory.

Add helpers `createTestUser(role)`, `createTestItem(userId, type)`, and `bootstrapComplete(page)` that call real routes or use D1 directly where authentication is not the subject of the test. Never hardcode real secrets.

steps.description: Add one passing and one negative check per layer
steps.details: Add a Vitest test asserting `/health` returns 200 and a Playwright test asserting the shell renders the catalog title. Temporarily add an intentionally failing assertion locally, confirm the non-zero exit, then remove it.
Add README entries for `pnpm test`, `pnpm test:watch`, `pnpm test:e2e`, and how to run a single test file.

technicalNotes: Use the official Cloudflare Vitest pool so `context.cloudflare.env` behaves like production.
Keep E2E fixtures free of real secrets and generated recovery keys that survive in the repo.
Browser tests must not depend on Internet access.

pullRequest.title: test: add Workers unit harness and Playwright E2E harness
pullRequest.scope: Vitest/Workers config, test DB setup, Playwright config, fixtures, smoke tests, docs.
pullRequest.outOfScope: Full critical-flow E2E coverage (that is TASK-24).
